title: A stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server helper of ASUSTOR ADM allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local…
description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the DHCP Server helper component of ASUSTOR ADM. An unauthenticated attacker on the local network can exploit this by sending a specially crafted DHCP hostname to a device with DHCP Server enabled. This may cause stack memory corruption and disrupt DHCP service. The affected versions include ASUSTOR ADM from 4.1.0 through 4.3.3.RY62 and from 5.0.0 through 5.1.4.RM62. The CVSS score is low, indicating limited impact severity.
